subject: youtube.policy_research.status
summary: The historical 2026-10-09 Council artifacts recover the main YouTube policy/monetization findings and anti-AI-slop rules; these are historical evidence and must still be revalidated against current platform policy before operational use.

historical_findings: YouTube Partner Program was documented as available in Iraq
repetitive or mass-produced inauthentic content was treated as monetization risk
originality is part of the product, not a post-production check
human-reviewed scripts and clear thesis/question are mandatory
FACT, INFERENCE and SPECULATION must remain separated where relevant
no AI shot merely to fill visual space
human voice is a core identity unless deliberately tested otherwise
no scale before the three-video pilot

source.ref: Library Council Media Venture artifacts dated 2026-10-09
